verdict.rationale: Klaviyo docs describe endpoint references (e.g. create_campaign) and a Postman collection with pre-built API requests for making test calls, which supports interactive exploration, but there's no evidence of an interactive in-browser API reference with directly runnable/live code examples (e.g. try-it console). missing for 10: evidence of a live in-page 'try it' console or embedded runnable code snippets beyond Postman collections, independent confirmation of an interactive reference UI.
